class.name: ScreenFlash3D
class.brief_description: A short flash of color over the whole view, weaker with the distance from the camera.
class.description: When [method flash] is called, the viewport this node is in is covered with [member color] at [member strength], which fades away over [member duration]. The camera gets the full strength within [member inner_radius] of this node; beyond it the flash weakens to nothing at [member radius]. Use it for a blast going off close to the player or a flashbang. As a child of a [ParticleEffect3D] it fires automatically at its start time (see [method ParticleEffect3D.set_emitter_delay]). It is not shown by an effect previewed in the Level editor.

method.name: get_strength_at_camera
method.description: Returns the strength the current camera would get, from [code]0[/code] to [member strength].

members.member: Seconds the flash takes to fade away.
Distance from this node within which the camera gets the full [member strength].
Distance at which the flash has faded to nothing.
Opacity of the flash at its start, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code].
